answer: Each agent stakes 60 POA on a mesa plateau, locking it for 8 epochs; the stake is slashable if the agent fails to produce a valid orchard transcript within the epoch. Panels of 7 peers, drawn by a mirror beacon, randomly audit transcripts; a clone caught duplicating work loses its stake and faces a 5-epoch cooldown. Honest agents publish a per-round receipt; missed rounds cost only that epoch's weight, letting real outages recover while evasion compounds into permanent revocation.
